newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian officials to discuss fuel crisis.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian officials to discuss fuel crisis.

text.p: Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation (NNPC) officials are to meet with the Nigerian Ports Authority (NPA) on Thursday to discuss a dispute which has led to a paralysing fuel crisis, an NNPC official said on Wednesday.
NNPC spokesman, Mohammed Jibrilla, told Reuters the two sides would try to reach an agreement that would allow NNPC to bring fuel into the commercial capital, Lagos.
NPA insists that NNPC pay a 4.0 billion naira ($50.3 million) debt before it will allow further shipments of fuel into Lagos.
Two vessels bringing a total of 22,000 tonnes of fuel were prevented from unloading on Tuesday.
Business in Lagos has been paralysed by the lack of fuel. Streets have been blocked by queues of hundreds of cars and buses at filling stations, forcing commuters to walk to work.
